title: Allsky Camera Upload Gap
app: Raspberry Shake, Safecast, Blitzortung-compatible lightning sensors, AirGradient CO2 sensors, radon monitors, allsky cameras, and magnetometers streamed to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=allsky:capture
| stats max(_time) as last_frame by camera
| eval minutes_since=round((now()-last_frame)/60,1)
| where minutes_since>15
| sort - minutes_since
description: Uses Allsky camera uploads telemetry to monitor how long each camera has gone without a frame in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for uptime gaps before a meteor shower or aurora night is missed, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Allsky camera uploads data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Camera table of minutes since last frame.
grandmaExplanation: It produces how long each camera has gone without a frame so you can spot uptime gaps before a meteor shower or aurora night is missed before it becomes annoying.
